description: RETScreen is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada; NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER). This tool gives professionals and decision makers a way to rapidly identify, assess, and optimize the technical and financial viability of potential clean energy projects. This decision intelligence software platform also gives managers a way to measure and verify the actual performance of their facilities and helps find additional energy savings/production opportunities. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality. Assets: Energy and Utilities, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
